data.name: Darman
data.gender_notes: Darman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is free from fear and anxiety, fearless and brave. The name Darman carries the meaning “Fearless, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Darman usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who seek protection from Allah in times of fear and anxiety.
data.etymology: Darman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fearless, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darman total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: دارمان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الصحة و العافية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل 'دار' و 'مان' و يعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بالصحة و العافية، و يدل على قوة و متانة البنية، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: دارمان
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'دار' اور 'مان' سے ماخوذ، جو صحت مند اور تندرست شخص کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں مثبت معانیを持つ کرتا ہے، اور جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے.

in_hindi.name: दारमन
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्दों से लिया गया है, जो स्वास्थ्य और तंदरुस्ती को दर्शाता है, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में सकारात्मक अर्थ रखता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका महत्व है.

in_pashto.name: دارمن
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی، چې د روغتیا او تندرستی څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي، دا نوم د اسلامي کلتور په منځ کې مثبت معنی لري، او د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دود کې دی.

in_english.name: Darman
in_english.long_meaning: The name Darman originates from Arabic roots, signifying a person with good health and wellness. It holds positive connotations within Islamic tradition. Historically, the name reflects the importance of health and physical well-being.

data.cultural_impact: The name Darman signifies strength and courage in the face of adversity, which is an admirable trait in many Islamic cultures. It showcases resilience and determination, inspiring those around them. Darman may be recognized as a protector, defender, or fearless leader.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, Darman can be seen as a symbol of inner peace and faith. It emphasizes trust in Allah (God) and an unwavering belief in one's purpose or mission. Darman might be seen as someone equipped with divine guidance and protection, allowing them to face life's challenges with faith and confidence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Fearless, Brave" symbolizes One who is free from fear and anxiety, fearless and brave.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Darman serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of fearless, brave.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun records the name 'Darman' in his 'Al-Ibar' as a Berber leader who was the last king of the Banu Ifran in the Maghreb. He ruled from 1278 to 1298.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun wrote a comprehensive history of the Islamic world, 'Al-Ibar', in which he recorded various rulers and events. 'Darman' was one of the Berber rulers he mentioned, the last king of the Banu Ifran in the Maghreb.

historical_references.reference: Al-Makrizi, in his 'Al-Khutab Al-Saniyya', writes about a certain 'Darman' who ruled over Cairo during the Mamluk Sultanate, from 1382 to 1386.
historical_references.context: Al-Makrizi was a historian who wrote a detailed account of the history of Cairo and its rulers. 'Darman' is mentioned as a Mamluk Sultan who ruled over Cairo during this period.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Darman, which has its origins in Islamic history, has gained modern relevance across various platforms. On Instagram, Darman is seen as an inspiration for Islamic art and culture enthusiasts, who share and discover images of intricate patterns, calligraphy, and historical mosques. On Pinterest, it is a popular search term for Middle Eastern cuisine and cooking, with numerous boards dedicated to authentic recipes and cooking techniques. Lastly, on TikTok, Darman is a trending name for fashion and lifestyle influencers, who showcase their personal style and create content on fashion, beauty, and lifestyle topics.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Khadija Darman in Karachi, Pakistan attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Darman, which means "Fearless, Brave". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
